_meta.source: illustrative published Mistral small rates, for the local Ollama live test
_meta.note: Ollama runs mistral-small locally for $0. To make the live test show real DOLLARS, we price the REAL token usage at Mistral's published small-model rate (~$0.10/1M in, $0.30/1M out). This is honest re-pricing of real usage (REQ-CM-8), not a real invoice.
